svg.title: IDEA Engineering system context
svg.desc: Engineers, reviewers and scoped administrators use IDEA Engineering. Office and CAD applications are external editing tools, a company identity provider is a future option, and authorized recipients consume exact read-only Release Packages. IDEA remains the product-data authority.
